description: Reverse geocoding of a house deep inside a block (osmandapp/OsmAnd#25258, Brest): 90/4 вуліца Суворава is 43 m from the point, its street 369 m away, while Лазовая вуліца passes at 87 m with its house 23 at 56 m. Guards STOP_SEARCHING_STREET_WITH_MULTIPLIER_RADIUS = 400 in GeocodingUtilities: with 250 m the street is cut from the roads of reverseGeocodingSearch and the house of the neighbouring street is returned.
note: geocoding: the first address of the point as <house>, <street>, <city>
